name: @playliquid/runtime-contracts
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Runtime/Experience Protocol contracts (PL-003). Typed runtime session lifecycle, the single canonical command/event path, the capability-mediated action protocol, multiplayer authority contracts, long-running work contracts, idempotency/stale-result semantics, replay/resume boundaries, and the Spark target profile. Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no engine SDKs, no client implementation.
